title: Insight7 Voice AI Agents for User Research Workflows
summary: Insight7 voice AI agents handle customer interviews, transcription, and synthesis to eliminate manual data processing tasks for product teams.
body_markdown:
## Automating research workflows with Activepieces and Insight7


Activepieces moves Insight7’s autonomous research outputs into your existing production environments via 748+ integrations without requiring a custom-coded backend.


By treating Insight7 as a standardized node within an automation flow, you ensure that raw interview data never sits idle in a silo where stakeholders will likely ignore it.


### Connecting via the HTTP request integration


Activepieces uses the HTTP Request integration to send interview transcripts to Insight7 for immediate analysis, a capability used by companies like MoneyGram and Moneypenny to bridge disparate data sources.


Because Insight7 supports standard REST API protocols, you can trigger an analysis the moment a recording finishes in a meeting tool like Zoom or Google Meet.


This connection eliminates the manual export-import cycle that typically delays research synthesis by several days. The following steps outline the configuration required to bridge these two environments, which means the user must follow this sequence to ensure data flows correctly between the systems.


Configure the Insight7 API endpoint within the HTTP Request integration to define where the system processes the data.


Map JSON fields to Google Sheets to ensure the system logs every insight in a structured format. Set a Slack notification trigger to alert the product team as soon as the synthesis is complete.


Activepieces makes every connector used in these flows instantly available as an agent tool.


As defined in the Integrations Framework and the MCP Server documentation in the open source repo, the same integration action that runs in a flow is the one exposed as an MCP tool for your research agents.


This unified catalog means you never have to wire up the same Insight7 integration twice to use it across both deterministic flows and autonomous agents.


This sequence transforms a static file into a live data stream. The research team becomes the engine of the organization rather than its bottleneck.


### Using OpenAI-compatible providers for custom logic


Insight7 integrates with the OpenAI-compatible provider framework in Activepieces. This allows teams to layer advanced reasoning models like Claude Fable 5.2 or GPT-6 Astra over their research data.


By selecting the "OpenAI" integration in Activepieces and swapping the base URL to point to your Insight7 environment, you can use these frontier models to perform specialized tasks such as sentiment scoring or feature request categorization.


Patterns across hundreds of interviews that a human researcher might miss are easier to identify when you leverage the reasoning capabilities of Claude Fable 5.2.


Using a standardized endpoint means you can swap between different reasoning engines as your project requirements change without rebuilding your entire automation logic from scratch.


### Scaling research data to your CRM


Sending synthesized insights directly to a CRM like Salesforce or a project management tool like Jira ensures that customer feedback is visible to the people building the product.


When Insight7 identifies a recurring pain point, Activepieces can automatically create a new record or update an existing lead. Sales and engineering teams receive direct quotes and validated evidence.


While an SDK provides the code for these transfers, Activepieces provides the governance. The platform treats each AI agent as a distinct user, applying Enterprise RBAC and SSO policies to control which CRM records an agent can access or modify.


By checking the run detail view for any research step, teams can audit every individual tool call and its specific input-output payload, ensuring the agent operates within the same security model as a human researcher.


Valuable user feedback is often buried in PDF reports, creating "research debt." By syncing these outputs to the tools your team already uses, you turn qualitative research into a high-velocity signal that informs every sprint and sales call.
